Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: 2026 attestation opens Mon 09:00 PT. Two core asks: 1) everyone completes the 12-min privacy microtraining, 2) each team uploads one SOC2-relevant artifact OR files a ticket assigning an evidence owner. :clipboard:
Maya (People Ops): Upload guide + checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations. Preferred path: /attestations/2026/<team>/. Please use team folder names exactly.
Pete (Eng): Small teams question — if we have <3 headcount, can a single manager attest for the group?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — small teams (<3) may use a manager attestation note, but list individual names in the ticket. Auditors want clear owner mapping.
Arjun (Security): If you're using tickets as interim evidence, include: owner, ETA, and expected artifact type. That satisfies the sweep but sampled teams will need logs/exports.
Nina (HR): Contractors: either upload certs or manager attestation in the ticket (signed). We need that for sampling.
Maya (People Ops): Quick acceptable artifacts list (copyable):
- Runbook/playbook (PDF/MD)
- IAM export (CSV)
- Backup manifest (CSV/JSON)
- KMS/key rotation export
- Change-control ticket with approvals
Integration Bot: Microtraining assigned: "Privacy Refresher 2026". Link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Pete (Eng): We're doing a release Tue AM. Can eng request a 48h scoped extension?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — extensions up to 72h for release conflicts. File ticket titled `Compliance extension - <team> - <reason>` and CC @Arjun. Keep training on time.
Arjun (Security): Pro tip: redact customer identifiers in docs; provide internal IDs if possible. Legal can help with redaction.
Maya (People Ops): Compliance Bot will run checks 72h/48h/24h before close and DM missing owners. We'll post a final @here 6h before close. Office hours Thursday 10:00 PT with Security & Legal — portal link on the checklist.
Pete (Eng): Uploaded runbook + IAM export to /attestations/2026/eng/ just now.
Maya (People Ops): Awesome, thanks. If anyone's unsure, open a ticket `TEAM - Attestation 2026 - owner: <name>` and mark `evidence: pending` with ETA — auditors accept that as interim evidence.
Integration Bot: This thread has been pinned to #people-ops for attestation coordination.
